_說明:
說明頁三層導覽（產品 → 主機平台 → 軟體）的單一來源。gen-guides.mjs 讀這份產生 sensors/

//index.md 與 .md，build.mjs 讀 _build/generated/guides-index.json 做切換列、格子、側欄、首頁選擇器。設計見 _build/guides/DESIGN.md。summaryMatch／colMatch 是 JavaScript regex（不分大小寫），用來從範例頁挑出這個軟體的

、下載表的欄、下載連結。readWith = protocol/snippets/<模組>.mjs 的 bySoftware(sw) 讀法。legacy = 舊頁檔名 → 新頁（'' = 平台頁）；舊頁頁首會加 標記。

tagline.zh: 樂高 SPIKE Prime（黃色主機）與 Robot Inventor（藍綠色主機）
tagline.en: LEGO SPIKE Prime (yellow hub) and Robot Inventor (teal hub)

edition.zh: 買 **SPIKE 版**（樂高 LPF2 接頭），直接插主機 A~F 任一孔，不用電池。SPIKE Prime 教育版（黃色主機）和 Robot Inventor 家用版（藍綠色主機）都能用。
edition.en: Get the **SPIKE edition** (LEGO LPF2 plug) and plug it into any hub port A~F; no battery needed. Works with SPIKE Prime (yellow hub) and Robot Inventor (teal hub).

q.en: The hub does not detect the sensor?

a.zh: 拔掉重插一次，等 2 秒；換一個孔試試。官方 App 會把它顯示成「顏色感應器」，這是正常的。
a.en: Unplug and replug, wait 2 s, try another port. The official app shows it as a colour sensor — that is expected.

q.zh: 可以同時用官方 App 和 Pybricks 嗎？
q.en: Can I use the official app and Pybricks on the same hub?

a.zh: 一次只能裝一種韌體：Pybricks 與 MBC 積木網站用 Pybricks 韌體，官方 App 用樂高原廠韌體；隨時可以用 SPIKE App 換回原廠韌體。
a.en: One firmware at a time: Pybricks and the MBC Blocks website need Pybricks firmware, the official app needs LEGO firmware; you can switch back any time with the SPIKE app.

tagline.zh: 學校最常用；不用換韌體，用顏色感應器積木讀
tagline.en: What most schools use; no firmware change, read with the colour-sensor blocks

colMatch.zh: 樂高官方 App|官方 App

tagline.zh: 中文積木、讀得到全部數值；主機換 Pybricks 韌體
tagline.en: Block coding with every value available; hub runs Pybricks firmware

tagline.zh: 打字寫 Python，最快、最完整；比賽隊伍首選
tagline.en: Type Python: fastest and most complete; the pick of competition teams

tagline.zh: 樂高 MINDSTORMS EV3 主機（RJ12 接頭）

edition.zh: 買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**；數字不動時拔掉重插一次。
edition.en: Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**; replug if the numbers freeze.

q.zh: EV3 顯示成紅外線感應器？
q.en: The EV3 shows an infrared sensor?

a.zh: 正常：感應器模擬成樂高原廠感應器，用原廠積木就能讀。
a.en: Expected: the sensor emulates a LEGO sensor so the stock blocks can read it.

q.en: A short freeze when switching modes?

a.zh: EV3 每次換模式要等約 1 秒。整趟任務盡量只用同一個模式的積木。
a.en: The EV3 needs about 1 s per mode change. Stick to one mode during a run.

tagline.zh: 學校電腦教室、WRO 隊伍最常見
tagline.en: Common in school labs and WRO teams

tagline.zh: 跟 SPIKE 一樣的積木，第一次用 EV3 也好上手
tagline.en: Same blocks as SPIKE; easy for first-time EV3 users

tagline.zh: Python 文字程式，讀得到所有模式
tagline.en: Python code with access to every mode

tagline.zh: BASIC 文字程式，已經在用 clev3r 的人
tagline.en: BASIC text code for existing clev3r users

tagline.zh: Arduino UNO、Nano、UNO R4、ESP32，用 I2C 接
tagline.en: Arduino UNO, Nano, UNO R4, ESP32 over I2C

edition.zh: 買 **通用 I2C 版**（4 pin：5V、GND、SDA、SCL），出廠 I2C 位址 `{{addr}}`。UNO／Nano 接 A4（SDA）、A5（SCL）；UNO R4、ESP32 接板子上標 SDA／SCL 的腳。
edition.en: Get the **Universal I2C edition** (4 pins: 5V, GND, SDA, SCL), factory I2C address `{{addr}}`. UNO / Nano: A4 (SDA), A5 (SCL); UNO R4 and ESP32: the pins marked SDA / SCL.

a.zh: 代表模組沒回應：檢查 SDA／SCL 有沒有接反、位址對不對、5V／GND 有沒有接好。
a.en: The module is not answering: check SDA / SCL are not swapped, the address is right and 5V / GND are connected.

a.zh: 可以，每顆位址要不同；同型號用命令 F8 換位址（見通用 I2C 協議）。
a.en: Yes, each needs its own address; re-address identical sensors with command F8 (see the universal I2C protocol).

tagline.zh: 複製範例、上傳就能用；每一行都有中文說明
tagline.en: Copy an example and upload; every line is commented
mBot, Ranger, Orion, MegaPi with mBlock 5 blocks

edition.zh: 買 **MakeBlock 版**（RJ25 接頭），插 mBot／Ranger／Orion／MegaPi 的 RJ25 連接埠；各主板可用哪幾個埠見 [MakeBlock 積木擴展](/makeblock.md)。
edition.en: Get the **MakeBlock edition** (RJ25 plug) and plug it into an RJ25 port of mBot / Ranger / Orion / MegaPi; usable ports per board are listed in [MakeBlock extension](/en/makeblock.md).

a.zh: 確認積木選的連接埠跟實際插的一樣，並且已經用「上傳」模式把程式燒進主板。
a.en: Check the port in the block matches the real port and that the program was uploaded to the board.

q.en: Does the old extension still work?

a.zh: 2026-10 以前出貨的感應器用舊版擴展 v1.0.0；新舊積木不相容，依韌體版本選。
a.en: Sensors shipped before 2026-10 use the legacy v1.0.0 extension; old and new blocks are not compatible.

tagline.zh: 裝 MBC 擴展後用中文積木讀值
tagline.en: Add the MBC extension and read values with blocks

tagline.zh: MATRIX Mini R4 主機，用 MATRIXblock 積木
tagline.en: MATRIX Mini R4 controller with MATRIXblock

edition.zh: 買 **MATRIX 版**，用 MATRIX 原廠 4 pin 感應器線接 Mini R4 的 I2C1 或 I2C2（位址 `0x22`），積木裡選對應的孔。
edition.en: Get the **MATRIX edition** and connect it with the stock MATRIX 4-pin cable to I2C1 or I2C2 of the Mini R4 (address `0x22`); pick that port in the block.

q.zh: 原廠積木和大通道可以一起用嗎？
q.en: Can I mix stock blocks and the big channel?

a.zh: 不行：兩種要裝不同的函式庫檔，一個程式只能選一種。
a.en: No: they need different library files; pick one per program.

longName.zh: MATRIXblock 原廠顏色感應器積木（0x22）

tagline.zh: 不用換函式庫，R~K 七個數就夠用
tagline.en: No library change; seven numbers R~K

tagline.zh: 換函式庫，一包 30 byte 什麼都讀得到
tagline.en: Swap the library and read everything in one 30-byte packet

tagline.zh: 神攝手走串口，用內建攝影機積木讀
tagline.en: The camera talks serial; read it with the built-in camera blocks
micro:bit V1 / V2 with MakeCode blocks

edition.zh: 買 **通用 I2C 版**，接 micro:bit 擴充板的 I2C 孔（SDA = P20、SCL = P19），出廠位址 `{{addr}}`。這款耗電小，VCC 可以先接 micro:bit 的 **3V** 腳（V1 約 90 mA、V2 約 190 mA）；用電池供電時電壓可能掉到 3 V 以下，不穩就改外接 5 V（GND 要和 micro:bit 共地）。
edition.en: Get the **Universal I2C edition** and connect it to the I2C header of a micro:bit breakout (SDA = P20, SCL = P19), factory address `{{addr}}`. It draws little current, so VCC can go to the micro:bit **3V** pin (about 90 mA on V1, 190 mA on V2); on batteries the rail can sag below 3 V, so switch to external 5 V if readings are unstable (share GND with the micro:bit).

a.zh: MakeCode「擴充功能」貼上 https://github.com/contactmbcrobot/pxt-mbc-sensors 加入。

tagline.zh: 加入 pxt-mbc-sensors 擴充，積木或 JavaScript 都可以
tagline.en: Add the pxt-mbc-sensors extension; blocks or JavaScript

ev3.zh:
買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**，**插頭一次插到底**；數字不動或 EV3 認錯時，拔掉重插一次。

> [!NOTE]
> **EV3 版不能從主機下命令給感應器**：格式跟原廠紅外線感應器完全相同，EV3（原廠韌體、Pybricks、ev3dev）都送不了 MBC 命令。要下命令請用 SPIKE／Arduino 等。
ev3.en:
Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**, **pushing the plug all the way in, in one go**; replug if the numbers freeze or the EV3 detects the wrong device.

> [!NOTE]
> **The EV3 edition cannot take commands from the hub**: it uses exactly the same format as the LEGO infrared sensor, so the EV3 (stock firmware, Pybricks, ev3dev) cannot send MBC commands. To send commands, use SPIKE, Arduino, etc.

ev3.zh:
買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**，**插頭一次插到底**；數字不動或 EV3 認錯時，拔掉重插一次。

> [!TIP]
> **EV3 實測通過（2026-11-02）**：原廠 EV3 韌體（EV3-G／EV3 Classroom／clev3r）、Pybricks v4 實測通過；ev3dev／EV3 MicroPython v2 支援（模式表跟原廠紅外線感應器相同）。EV3 把它認成**紅外線感應器**（type 33）。

- **EV3 切換感應器模式約要 1.1 秒**（原廠紅外線感應器也一樣）：程式固定讀一個模式，不要在迴圈裡輪流切。

> [!NOTE]
> **EV3 版不能從主機下命令給感應器**：格式跟原廠紅外線感應器完全相同，EV3（原廠韌體、Pybricks、ev3dev）都送不了 MBC 命令。要下命令請用 SPIKE／Arduino 等。
ev3.en:
Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**, **pushing the plug all the way in, in one go**; replug if the numbers freeze or the EV3 detects the wrong device.

> [!TIP]
> **Tested on the EV3 (2026-11-02)**: the stock EV3 firmware (EV3-G / EV3 Classroom / clev3r) and Pybricks v4 pass; ev3dev / EV3 MicroPython v2 are supported (same mode table as the LEGO infrared sensor). The EV3 detects it as an **infrared sensor** (type 33).

- **Switching sensor modes on the EV3 takes about 1.1 s** (the same for the LEGO infrared sensor): read one mode only and do not switch modes inside a loop.

> [!NOTE]
> **The EV3 edition cannot take commands from the hub**: it uses exactly the same format as the LEGO infrared sensor, so the EV3 (stock firmware, Pybricks, ev3dev) cannot send MBC commands. To send commands, use SPIKE, Arduino, etc.

arduino.zh:
買 **通用 I2C 版**（4 pin：5V、GND、SDA、SCL），出廠 I2C 位址 `{{addr}}`。UNO／Nano 接 A4（SDA）、A5（SCL）；UNO R4、ESP32 接板子上標 SDA／SCL 的腳。

> [!TIP]
> **Arduino 實測通過（2026-11-06，Arduino Nano）**：身分與值表、線位置左右方向（線在左＝負）、E7 5 秒校準、E2／E3 黑白校準、E1／E0 白線模式、E4 門檻、E9 左右反向、EF 重開機都照說明；100 kHz 連續讀 2000 次、400 kHz 連續讀 500 次都沒有讀錯。兩條線／T 字分岔這次沒有測。
>
> 16 路的 I2C 腳耐 5 V：Arduino 端 I2C 讀錯時，可以跟 8 路一樣在 A4／A5 加 4.7 kΩ 上拉電阻到 5 V。
arduino.en:
Get the **Universal I2C edition** (4 pins: 5V, GND, SDA, SCL), factory I2C address `{{addr}}`. UNO / Nano: A4 (SDA), A5 (SCL); UNO R4 and ESP32: the pins marked SDA / SCL.

> [!TIP]
> **Tested on Arduino (2026-11-06, Arduino Nano)**: identity and value table, line position direction (line on the left = negative), E7 5-second calibration, E2 / E3 black and white calibration, E1 / E0 white-line mode, E4 threshold, E9 left/right swap and EF restart all behave as documented; 2000 reads in a row at 100 kHz and 500 at 400 kHz with no errors. Two lines / T-junction branching was not tested this time.
>
> The 16-Way I2C pins are 5 V tolerant: if the Arduino gets I2C errors, you can add 4.7 kΩ pull-ups from A4 / A5 to 5 V, the same as for the 8-Way.

matrix.zh:
買 **MATRIX 版**，用 MATRIX 原廠 4 pin 感應器線接 Mini R4 的 I2C1 或 I2C2（位址 `0x22`），積木裡選對應的孔。

> [!TIP]
> **MATRIX Mini R4 實測通過（2026-11-06）**：MATRIXblock 原廠顏色感應器積木（位址 0x22）讀到的線位置、細位置、線寬、光值都對（線在左＝負），白底、線在中間、左、右都照說明；連續讀 2000 次沒有錯。
matrix.en:
Get the **MATRIX edition** and connect it with the stock MATRIX 4-pin cable to I2C1 or I2C2 of the Mini R4 (address `0x22`); pick that port in the block.

> [!TIP]
> **Tested on MATRIX Mini R4 (2026-11-06)**: the stock MATRIXblock colour-sensor blocks (address 0x22) read the line position, fine position, line width and light values correctly (line on the left = negative) on white, centred, left and right; 2000 reads in a row with no errors.

ev3.zh:
買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**，**插頭一次插到底**；數字不動或 EV3 認錯時，拔掉重插一次。

> [!TIP]
> **EV3 實測通過（2026-11-03）**：原廠 EV3 韌體（EV3-G／EV3 Classroom／clev3r）、Pybricks v4 實測通過；ev3dev／EV3 MicroPython v2 支援（模式表跟原廠紅外線感應器相同）。EV3 把它認成**紅外線感應器**（type 33）。

- **EV3 切換感應器模式約要 1.1 秒**（原廠紅外線感應器也一樣）：程式固定讀一個模式，不要在迴圈裡輪流切。
- **沒有線時，模式 0 停在最後看到線的那一側**（負＝左、正＝右），不是 0。
- **模式 3（位元圖）第 16 路（CH15）壓到線時會讀成負數**：先 `& 0xFFFF` 再看每一位。
- **EV3 版不支援主機下命令**（原廠韌體、Pybricks、ev3dev 都不能下 E0～E9；格式跟原廠紅外線感應器完全相同）。替代做法：**插上電時按住板子按鍵＝白線模式**（沒按＝黑線）；運作中按校準按鈕＝5 秒動態校準。左右反向、門檻 EV3 版沒有，要用請改 SPIKE 版或 I2C 版。
ev3.en:
Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**, **pushing the plug all the way in, in one go**; replug if the numbers freeze or the EV3 detects the wrong device.

> [!TIP]
> **Tested on the EV3 (2026-11-03)**: the stock EV3 firmware (EV3-G / EV3 Classroom / clev3r) and Pybricks v4 pass; ev3dev / EV3 MicroPython v2 are supported (same mode table as the LEGO infrared sensor). The EV3 detects it as an **infrared sensor** (type 33).

- **Switching sensor modes on the EV3 takes about 1.1 s** (the same for the LEGO infrared sensor): read one mode only and do not switch modes inside a loop.
- **With no line in view, mode 0 stays at the side where the line was last seen** (negative = left, positive = right), not 0.
- **Mode 3 (bitmap): channel 16 (CH15) reads as a negative number when it is on the line**: apply `& 0xFFFF` before checking the bits.
- **The EV3 edition cannot take commands from the hub** (stock firmware, Pybricks and ev3dev cannot send E0~E9; the format is exactly the same as the LEGO infrared sensor). Instead: **hold the board button while powering up = white-line mode** (not pressed = black line); press the calibration button while running = 5-second dynamic calibration. Left/right swap and thresholds are not available on the EV3 edition; use the SPIKE or I2C edition for those.

買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**，**插頭一次插到底**；EV3 認錯（顯示成 NXT I2C／能量表）或數字不動時，拔掉重插。

> [!TIP]
> **原廠 EV3 韌體實測通過（2026-11-02）**：認成原廠陀螺儀、原廠歸零積木可用、7 個模式讀值正確、切模式 300 次與連續讀不斷線。**ev3dev**：支援。
ev3.en:
Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**, **pushing the plug all the way in, in one go**. If the EV3 detects the wrong device (NXT I2C or Energy Meter) or the numbers freeze, unplug it and plug it back in.

> [!TIP]
> **Tested on the stock EV3 firmware (2026-11-02):** detected as the LEGO gyro sensor, the stock gyro reset block works, all 7 modes read correctly, and 300 mode switches plus continuous reading never dropped the connection. **ev3dev:** supported.

ev3.zh:
買 **EV3 版**（RJ12 接頭），插 EV3 的 1~4 號感應器孔。**EV3 先開機再插感應器**，**插頭一次插到底**；數字不動或 EV3 認錯時，拔掉重插一次。

> [!NOTE]
> **EV3 版不能從主機下命令給感應器**：格式跟原廠紅外線感應器完全相同，EV3（原廠韌體、Pybricks、ev3dev）都送不了 MBC 命令。要下命令請用 SPIKE／Arduino 等。
ev3.en:
Get the **EV3 edition** (RJ12 plug) and plug it into sensor port 1~4. **Power the EV3 on first, then plug the sensor in**, **pushing the plug all the way in, in one go**; replug if the numbers freeze or the EV3 detects the wrong device.

> [!NOTE]
> **The EV3 edition cannot take commands from the hub**: it uses exactly the same format as the LEGO infrared sensor, so the EV3 (stock firmware, Pybricks, ev3dev) cannot send MBC commands. To send commands, use SPIKE, Arduino, etc.

microbit.zh: 買 **通用 I2C 版**，接 micro:bit 擴充板的 I2C 孔（SDA = P20、SCL = P19），出廠位址 `{{addr}}`。**一定要外接 5 V 供電**（8 顆雷射同時量測，電流超過 micro:bit 3V 腳能給的），不能吃 micro:bit 的 3V 腳；外部電源的 GND 要和 micro:bit 共地。
microbit.en: Get the **Universal I2C edition** and connect it to the I2C header of a micro:bit breakout (SDA = P20, SCL = P19), factory address `{{addr}}`. It **must use an external 5 V supply** (8 lasers measure at once, more current than the micro:bit 3V pin can supply), not the micro:bit 3V pin; share the supply GND with the micro:bit.

spike.zh: EXP6 的「Host 通訊線」插 SPIKE Prime 主機任一孔（SPIKE Prime；Robot Inventor（51515）主機只能用 Robot Inventor App 的 Python；不支援 EV3），另外要接獨立電源給馬達。
spike.en: Plug the EXP6 host cable into any SPIKE Prime port (SPIKE Prime; on a Robot Inventor (51515) hub, Python in the Robot Inventor App only; not EV3) and connect a separate power supply for the motors.

arduino.zh: EXP6 **不能用 I2C** 接 Arduino（主機接頭的隔離晶片只能單向傳送）；改用 **序列埠（UART）**，建議 Arduino UNO R4、Mega 或 ESP32。
arduino.en: The EXP6 **cannot use I2C** with Arduino (the host-port isolator is one-way); use **serial (UART)** instead, ideally with an Arduino UNO R4, Mega or ESP32.

spike.zh: Servo6 插 SPIKE Prime 主機任一孔，舵機接擴充器的 1~6 號孔。舵機的電由主機經擴充器供給，不用另外接電池。
spike.en: Plug the Servo6 into any SPIKE Prime port and connect servos to its ports 1~6. The servos are powered by the hub through the Servo6; no separate battery is needed.

主機認不到感應器？.zh: 拔掉重插一次，等 2 秒；換一個孔試試。官方 App 會把它顯示成「距離感應器（超音波）」，這是正常的。
主機認不到感應器？.en: Unplug and replug, wait 2 s, try another port. The official app shows it as a distance (ultrasonic) sensor — that is expected.
